intro: The Unsweetened Black Tea (16 oz) from CAVA offers a refreshing, zero-calorie beverage option that pairs perfectly with any meal from the [full CAVA menu](/). Made with premium brewed black tea and no added sugars or sweeteners, this drink provides a clean, crisp taste that complements CAVA's Mediterranean flavors. At just $3.45, it is an ideal choice for health-conscious diners seeking authentic refreshment.
priceCalories: Priced at $3.45 for a 16 oz serving, the Unsweetened Black Tea delivers exceptional value with absolutely zero calories. This makes it one of the most budget-friendly and diet-friendly options on the [CAVA Drinks Menu](/menu/drinks). With 0g protein, 0g carbs, and 0g fat, it fits seamlessly into any nutritional plan without compromising your dietary goals or adding unnecessary calories to your meal.
whatMakesSpecial: What sets CAVA's Unsweetened Black Tea apart is its simplicity and purity. Unlike many restaurant beverages loaded with sugars and artificial ingredients, this drink contains only brewed black tea. The zero-calorie profile makes it a standout choice for those tracking their intake using the [CAVA Nutrition Calculator](/calculator). It offers authentic tea flavor without sweeteners, preservatives, or additives that compromise quality.
nutritionFacts: The Unsweetened Black Tea (16 oz) features an impressively clean nutrition profile with 0 calories, 0g protein, 0g carbohydrates, and 0g fat. This beverage contains no sugar, making it compatible with keto, low-carb, and diabetic-friendly diets. It also appears on the [CAVA Gluten Free Menu](/gluten-free) and [CAVA Allergen Menu](/allergen-menu) as a safe option for those with dietary restrictions or food sensitivities.
whatsInside: This drink contains just one simple ingredient: brewed black tea. CAVA sources quality tea leaves that are carefully brewed to extract rich flavor and natural antioxidants. There are no added sugars, artificial sweeteners, flavors, colors, or preservatives. The pure composition makes it an excellent choice for those who appreciate authentic beverage options that complement selections from the [CAVA Mains Menu](/menu/mains) and other categories.
tasteLike: The Unsweetened Black Tea delivers a bold, slightly astringent flavor profile characteristic of premium black tea. It offers earthy, malty notes with a clean finish that refreshes the palate without any sweetness. The natural tannins provide a crisp, sophisticated taste that cuts through rich Mediterranean flavors. Unlike sweetened alternatives, this tea allows the natural tea leaf character to shine through in every sip.
customize: While the Unsweetened Black Tea comes perfectly balanced as-is, you can customize it to your preference. Request extra ice for a more chilled experience, or ask for light ice if you prefer stronger tea flavor. Some guests add a splash of Classic Lemonade for subtle sweetness, or squeeze fresh lemon for citrus brightness. The clean base makes it versatile for personalization without starting with unwanted sugars.
pairsWell: This refreshing tea pairs exceptionally well with nearly every item from the [CAVA Curated Bowls Menu](/menu/curated-bowls) and [CAVA Curated Pitas Menu](/menu/curated-pitas). Its clean, astringent quality complements rich options from the [CAVA Dips & Spreads Menu](/menu/dips-spreads) like hummus and tzatziki. The zero-calorie profile makes it ideal alongside indulgent choices from the [CAVA Desserts Menu](/menu/desserts), balancing your overall meal without adding extra calories.
healthyChoice: The Unsweetened Black Tea stands out as one of the healthiest beverage choices available at CAVA. With zero calories and no sugar, it supports weight management and blood sugar control. Black tea naturally contains antioxidants and polyphenols that may support heart health and metabolism. Unlike sugary drinks that can derail healthy eating goals, this tea complements nutritious selections from the [CAVA Toppings Menu](/menu/toppings) without compromise.
howToOrder: Ordering the Unsweetened Black Tea is simple and straightforward. When building your meal at CAVA, select it from the beverage section as you complete your order. Specify the 16 oz size and confirm no modifications unless you prefer customizations. The tea is freshly brewed and served over ice. You can order it in-store, through the CAVA app, or via delivery platforms for convenient refreshment.
vsAlternatives: Compared to the Classic Lemonade (16 oz) at 260 calories or Blueberry Lavender (16 oz) at 140 calories, the Unsweetened Black Tea offers zero-calorie refreshment at the same $3.45 price point. While flavored options provide sweetness, the black tea delivers sophisticated flavor without sugar. For those seeking calorie-free hydration with more flavor than water, this tea presents the perfect middle ground between plain and sweetened beverages.
whoShouldTry: The Unsweetened Black Tea is perfect for health-conscious diners, those following low-carb or keto diets, and anyone monitoring sugar intake. It appeals to tea enthusiasts who appreciate pure, unadulterated black tea flavor. Diabetics and calorie-counters will appreciate the zero-impact nutrition profile. If you are exploring options on the [CAVA Dressings Menu](/menu/dressings) or building a balanced bowl, this beverage complements without adding unnecessary calories.
worthTrying: Absolutely worth trying for anyone seeking a refreshing, zero-calorie beverage that does not compromise on flavor. At $3.45, it delivers exceptional value compared to sugary alternatives that add hundreds of calories. The pure brewed black tea offers sophistication and refreshment that enhances your CAVA dining experience. Whether you are a regular customer or first-time visitor, this drink represents smart, delicious hydration that supports your wellness goals.

faqs.q: How many calories are in the Unsweetened Black Tea (16 oz)?
faqs.a: The Unsweetened Black Tea contains 0 calories, making it an excellent choice for those watching their calorie intake or following a weight management plan.

faqs.q: What ingredients are in the Unsweetened Black Tea?
faqs.a: This beverage contains only one ingredient: brewed black tea. There are no added sugars, sweeteners, flavors, or preservatives in this simple, pure drink.

faqs.q: How much does the Unsweetened Black Tea (16 oz) cost?
faqs.a: The 16 oz Unsweetened Black Tea is priced at $3.45, offering excellent value for a zero-calorie, freshly brewed beverage option at CAVA.

faqs.q: Is the Unsweetened Black Tea gluten-free and allergen-friendly?
faqs.a: Yes, the Unsweetened Black Tea is gluten-free and free from common allergens. It contains only brewed black tea with no added ingredients that would introduce allergen concerns.

faqs.q: Can I customize the Unsweetened Black Tea?
faqs.a: Yes, you can customize the tea by adjusting ice levels or adding fresh lemon. Some guests mix it with a splash of lemonade for a lightly sweetened Arnold Palmer variation.
